description: Model seller financing in a business acquisition: amortizing or interest-only, with optional standby months and interest treatment. Returns the monthly payment, the first full amortizing year of service, the balloon due at maturity, total interest, the share of the price the note carries and coverage when cash flow is given. Use when the user asks what a seller note costs or what is owed at the end.

amortizationYears.description: Years the payment amortizes over. Ignored when interest-only. Defaults to the maturity. In years.

annualCashFlow.description: Annual cash flow available for debt service, for a coverage check. In US dollars.

existingAnnualService.description: Annual service on other debt, such as the senior loan, for the coverage check. In US dollars.

noteAmount.description: Seller note principal. In US dollars.

noteRate.description: Note rate. Annual rate in percentage points. 9.25 means 9.25%.

purchasePrice.description: The purchase price, for the share the note carries. In US dollars.

repayment.description: Amortizing payments, or interest only with principal due at maturity.

standbyInterest.description: What happens to interest during standby months. "none": no interest accrues. "accrue-simple": interest accrues and is due at maturity. "capitalize-monthly": interest is added to principal each month.

standbyMonths.description: Months at the start with no payment.

name: model_seller_note
title: Model a seller note
